**Overview**
 The Windows Compatibility team plays a critical role in the development and delivery of Windows across a broad range of devices, architectures, and silicon, from laptops to gaming consoles. We build innovative solutions that ensure customers can continue using their favorite applications as Windows grows and evolves.
   

  

 As Windows continues to advance with new devices, AI\-powered experiences, and platform innovations, our team focuses on solving complex compatibility challenges and improving the overall Windows experience. We develop engineering tools, automation frameworks, and infrastructure that help identify, investigate, and resolve compatibility issues before they impact customers.
   

  

 We collaborate closely with Windows engineering teams and partners across Microsoft to deliver reliable, scalable solutions that support the future of Windows. We are expanding our team to help shape the next generation of compatibility engineering and create meaningful impact for millions of customers worldwide.
   

  

 As a
 **Software Engineer II** 
 on the Windows Compatibility team in Redmond, your work will directly impact Windows engineering teams globally. You will design and develop solutions that ensure critical application compatibility issues introduced during Windows development are identified and resolved before reaching customers.
   

  

 You will build and enhance compatibility engineering tools, automation systems, and data\-driven solutions using modern software engineering practices, AI technologies, and analytics. You will collaborate with engineers across Microsoft to investigate complex compatibility challenges, improve engineering processes, and influence solutions that enhance the Windows ecosystem.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 This opportunity will allow you to
   

  

* Develop Windows Compatibility tools, automation frameworks, and infrastructure to identify regressions and improve compatibility coverage.
* Design and implement scalable solutions that support compatibility validation, test automation, and new Windows platform scenarios.
* Enhance test authoring experiences by building AI\-powered solutions and leveraging emerging technologies.
* Modernize Compatibility Engineering tools by applying secure, reliable, and maintainable engineering practices.
* Investigate compatibility issues, perform root cause analysis, and deliver solutions that improve Windows customer experiences.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across Microsoft and external partners to understand compatibility challenges and drive effective solutions.
* Play a fundamental role in defining and building products and technologies used by millions of people.
* Develop innovative solutions using AI, automation, and data\-driven engineering approaches.
* Solve problems across Windows, operating systems, cloud technologies, and emerging platforms.
* Work in a team environment that encourages ownership, collaboration, and strategic impact.
* Partner with engineering teams across Microsoft to deliver high\-quality customer experiences.
* Invest in your professional development through continuous learning, mentorship, and hands\-on opportunities.
* Experience new engineering challenges that expand your technical skills and expertise.
* Work with a team that values inclusion, flexibility, innovation, and engineering excellence

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 3\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 5\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience.

Backend Engineer
As a Backend Engineer at Techstars, you will be the connective tissue between our data infrastructure and the product teams building Techstars OS — the operating system that drives how we run accelerators, support founders, and make investment decisions. You will own our data pipelines, keep our cloud infrastructure stable and secure, and work across teams to ship reliable, observable systems. This role blends backend data engineering with platform/infrastructure work; the right person is equally comfortable building an ELT pipeline as they are debugging a Kubernetes deployment
What you will do
Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve data across Techstars systems — including Salesforce, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and internal APIs
Own and evolve our Kubernetes-based infrastructure (Helm, OpenTofu, Github Actions), including deployment tooling, secrets management, and cluster health
Partner with our senior security engineer on infrastructure reliability — incident response, observability, and proactive improvements to keep things stable
Maintain and improve our PostgreSQL database layer: schema design, migrations, query performance, and data integrity
Support Salesforce data flows and integrations with our broader platform
Build and maintain internal tooling and integrations that connect third-party SaaS tools to Techstars OS
Contribute to engineering standards: CI/CD practices, testing, code review, documentation
Work in an agile team environment with a product backlog, sprints, and regular delivery to production
What you bring
Solid experience building and maintaining data pipelines — ETL/ELT, data ingestion, transformation, and delivery to downstream consumers
Proficiency with PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations, query optimization, data modeling
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production (AWS EKS a plus), including familiarity with Helm, kubectl, and debugging workloads
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (OpenTofu, Terraform)
Strong Python skills for data engineering, scripting, and automation
Strong understanding of agentic development in a team environment
Familiarity with AWS services (S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and related tooling)
A DevOps mindset: you care about observability (Prometheus/Grafana experience a plus), reliability, and what happens after code ships
Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills — you can work from symptoms to root cause on unfamiliar systems
Experience working in agile development environments with a product team
Strong communication skills — you work well across teams and can explain technical tradeoffs clearly
Nice to have
Experience with Salesforce data structures and CRM-adjacent integrations
Knowledge of financial or investment data (venture capital, startup portfolio management)
Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)
Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript for backend services
Prior work at a startup, accelerator, or investment firm
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary Range: 115,000 - 130,000
Benefits: Techstars offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off.

Join the team bringing advanced autonomy to the built world
   

  

 At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3\.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.
   

  

 We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.
   

  

 This is where algorithms meet steel\-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world\-class engineers to solve physical\-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.
   

  

**The Role**
 Bedrock Robotics is hiring a Data Scientist to lead high\-impact data science work across autonomy, safety, and product. In this role, you will operate as a senior technical individual contributor, partnering closely with autonomy, machine learning, backend, and product teams to extract insights from complex, real\-world data generated by autonomous construction machines and their operators.
   

  

 You will work across the full data science lifecycle (problem framing, analysis, measurement, and communication) while helping establish foundational practices for how data science is applied at Bedrock. This role is ideal for a senior\-to\-staff\-level data scientist who enjoys operating in ambiguous problem spaces, working close to production systems, and delivering insights that directly influence engineering and product decisions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own and execute data science work across autonomy, safety, and product, focusing on the highest\-impact analytical problems
* Analyze machine telemetry, operational data, and user workflows to surface insights that improve system performance, safety, and usability
* Define and track key metrics that measure system behavior and product outcomes
* Design and evaluate experiments, analyses, and validation approaches in partnership with engineering and product teams
* Collaborate closely with ML platform and data engineering teams to ensure data is accessible, reliable, and fit for analysis
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, influencing roadmap and design decisions
* Contribute to the foundation of data science practices at Bedrock, helping shape how future work and teams scale


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in data science, applied analytics, or applied machine learning roles
* Comfort operating as a senior IC in a fast\-growing startup, balancing execution with technical judgment and prioritization
* Ability to work independently, define analytical approaches, and drive projects from concept to insight
* Experience working with complex, high\-volume, or real\-time data (e.g., robotics, autonomy, geospatial systems, computer vision outputs, IoT, ad\-tech, or large\-scale consumer platforms)
* Strong grounding in statistics, experimental design, and data analysis, with a track record of influencing decisions through data
* Hands\-on experience collaborating with data engineering and infrastructure teams on data pipelines, data quality, and scalable analysis workflows
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using modern tooling like agentic AI
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (advanced degree welcome but not required)


**Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodations**
 We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.
